title: What Is a Hot Towel Shave? What Happens in the Chair
hero_alt: Hot towel wrapped around a reclined client's face before a shave
card_text: Towels, lather, razor, aftershave: every step of a hot towel shave, what the heat does, and which services include a towel.
lede: A hot towel shave is a traditional wet shave. Hot towels go on first to soften the beard and warm the skin, then shaving cream and a straight razor take the hair off, and an aftershave finishes it. At my shop that's the Straight Razor Beard Shave: {{price:straight-razor-beard-shave}} for {{minutes:straight-razor-beard-shave}} on Booksy.
Here's each step in order, what the heat actually does for the shave, and which other services bring a hot towel into the visit.

subsections.heading: Settle back
paragraphs: The chair reclines and your head rests back, like the client in the photo at the top. Open the collar or tuck it down so the towel can wrap the jaw and throat.

subsections.heading: The towels
paragraphs: Hot towels wrap the lower half of the face and stay there for a while. Warmth and moisture work into the whiskers, and that is what makes them easier to cut.

subsections.heading: The lather
paragraphs: Shaving cream goes on over the damp beard. It keeps the skin slick, so the blade glides across it instead of catching.

subsections.heading: The razor
paragraphs: Then the straight razor, with the skin held smooth under it. This is the part to stay still for, and it is the reason a proper shave is never hurried.

subsections.heading: The finish
paragraphs: A soothing aftershave goes on last, over skin that has just been shaved clean.
Run a hand along your jaw before you sit up. That smooth feel is what the towels, the lather and the slow razor work were for.

blocks.heading: What the towel does.
paragraphs: Dry whiskers are stiff. Warm water softens them, so the razor slices through instead of tugging. That is the real benefit people mean by a hot towel shave: less pulling, less scraping and a closer result on the first pass.
It's also the quietest part of any visit. Eyes closed, face warm, and nobody needs anything from you for a minute or two.
A hot towel is not a medical treatment. If your skin is irritated, broken out or sore, tell me before we start, and take anything that won't settle to a doctor.

blocks.heading: Where the towel shows up.
blocks.lead: Four services on my menu use hot towels.

items.title: Straight Razor Beard Shave
items.body: The full hot towel shave by itself: towels, premium shaving cream, the razor and a soothing aftershave, with no haircut attached.

items.title: Head & Beard Shave
items.body: The same idea for the scalp and the beard together: hot towels, a precision shave on both, and an aftershave balm to close. Booksy gives it a full hour.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: A haircut with a beard trim or line-up, straight razor detailing and a hot towel to finish. Here the towel comes at the end of the cut, not before a full shave.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: Two hot towels, facial steam, a beard sculpt, a wash with scalp massage and the haircut, all in one booking.

blocks.heading: Good to know.
paragraphs: Taking off a long, full beard? Text me a photo first at {{phone}}. Bringing a big beard down to skin is a bigger job than shaving a few days of growth, and it helps to know what's coming.
Want the hot towel but plan to keep the beard? Book the Signature Cut instead. Your beard gets trimmed or lined up with the haircut, and the visit still ends under a hot towel.
Shaving for a wedding, an interview or a photo? Book it close to the date. A smooth shave is at its cleanest right away, and growth starts showing again quickly.
You pay after the shave, by cash, card, Zelle or Cash App. If your plans change, cancel on Booksy early, because a no-show or late cancellation may carry a fee.

items.q: What is a hot towel shave?
items.a: A wet shave that opens with hot towels to soften the beard, followed by shaving cream, a straight razor and an aftershave.

items.q: What are the benefits of a hot towel shave?
items.a: Softened whiskers cut more cleanly, so the razor pulls less on the skin. The warmth is relaxing too, which is half the reason people book one.

items.q: How long does a hot towel shave take?
items.a: Booksy holds {{minutes:straight-razor-beard-shave}} for the Straight Razor Beard Shave and {{minutes:head-beard-shave}} for the Head & Beard Shave.

items.q: Can I get a hot towel with a haircut?
items.a: Yes. The Signature Cut finishes with a hot towel, and the Luxury Grooming Experience includes two.
